This system can be written as

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -6 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ -3\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}4 & -6 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{4\cdot 3-0\cdot (-6)}[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{12}[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{12}[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}9 \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
